blurb: Since 1993, Meadow Park Sports Centre (MPSC) has been Whistler’s main hub for fitness and recreation, featuring a lap pool, leisure pool, skating rink, weight and cardio rooms, studio fitness classes, squash courts, and an indoor basketball hoop. Booking is not required for fitness facilities, pool access, or ice sheet during open skate sessions.
